summary: Version 1.1.0 adds four illustrative organization arrangements to the October 23, 2026 edition 1.0.0. Corrected subsection labels and references across the reader and Markdown.

items.section: Match the structure to your coordination needs
items.title: Four illustrative organization arrangements
items.whatChanged: Added four illustrative organization arrangements, from one team to federated business units, after the discussion of shared expertise.
items.why: Helps leaders choose coordination and support arrangements while preserving team ownership. Company sizes are examples, not prescribed transition points.

items.title: Consistent title-only subsection labels
items.whatChanged: Removed decimal prefixes from website and Markdown subsection headings and linked references to visible titles.
items.why: Match the PDF presentation while preserving existing links. Both PDFs were reissued with this correction recorded.
